highlights.headline: COP31: Climate deal 'not adopted,' summit president says
highlights.summary: The summit was extended as nations worked to reach a deal, but they couldn't agree on including fossil fuels. European nations, small island states and activists have criticized oil-producing countries for the impasse.

highlights.headline: COP31 climate talks end without consensus on how to fund vulnerable countries or move the world away from coal, oil and gas use
highlights.summary: After two weeks of tough talks, the COP31 climate summit has closed without a consensus on how to quit fossil fuels or fund countries struggling to adapt to a hotter world.

items.title: EU officials reject Cop31 deal as it 'doesn't speak to reality of the climate crisis' – video
items.description: <p>The Cop31 climate talks fell into disarray as the EU, UK and allies in the developing world rejected what they called an unacceptable deal on the future of the climate. Ireland's climate minister, Darragh O'Brien, said the EU could not support the proposed deal, in part because it made no mention of fossil fuels.
